ecosystem_position.reason: Peer engagement, recorded VATE reproduction, and [current datatracker standing](https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-kondoju-evc/) support this band's upper end, but APS's adapter commitment targets a neutral mcp-use hook and does not establish deference to EVC. AuthZEN COAZ/AARP remains an active competing decision envelope; the evidence does not clearly establish the competitor repositioning required for 11–15.
